title: Aurora Coffee — indie publishing meets specialty coffee
tagline: From a generic SaaS-cafe template to a zine-maximalist register, Vintage Cottage Charm palette, and asymmetric editorial layouts.

source.note: Fictional brand for the stardust v2 fixture. The 'existing site' is a hand-authored generic SaaS-cafe template (Inter, blue accent #3B82F6, three-up feature card grid, 'lovingly roasted' marketing voice) — the redesign target the showcase samples diverge from.

direction.phrase: make it more expressive for a young audience
movements: audience: resolved Q1 → Gen Z college / first-job

antiToolbox.note: Hard non-blur drop shadow on display headlines: implemented as a 4px x-axis offset between two flat fills (Ink + Sage), encoding riso-print misregistration. Removing the offset removes the entire print metaphor.

variants.name: Editorial-split mast
variants.thesis: The home page leads with the riso-misregistered 'Aurora.' wordmark on Ground; right-hand pane is a Sage section with a Rose CTA band. The zine register reads first — the eye lands on the typewriter-tagged origin meta and the asymmetric 3/5 split before any product card.

current.note: Re-rendering of the existing fixture from current/pages/home.json against current/DESIGN.md. Generic SaaS-cafe template — Inter throughout, blue #3B82F6 CTAs, three-up feature card grid, 'lovingly roasted' marketing voice. The visual language stardust diverges from.
